title: A genome-wide map of the genetic network in monocytes that regulates type I interferon induction by the cGAS-STING pathway
model: THP-1 IFNB1-GFP reporter clones, MinLibCas9 genome-wide knockout library, cGAMP stimulation unprimed or IFN-a primed
contrast: GFP-negative vs GFP-high sort, paired by culture (4 vs 4), unprimed (primary) and IFN-a primed
paper_method: Not stated in the available text (paper not open access)
paper_calls: Genome-wide positive and negative regulators of cGAS-STING-induced IFNB1 in unprimed and primed cells; TBL1XR1 and HDAC3 highlighted
barcs_calls: Unprimed 14 genes at FDR 0.10 (11 positive regulators); primed 150 (126); no controls, so no calibration and no control null
named_hits: Ranks among positive regulators, unprimed / primed: TBL1XR1 #7 (FDR 0.03) / #187 (0.18); HDAC3 #164 (0.69) / #114 (0.09); STING #1 / #1; TBK1 #2 / #348
verdict: BARCS recovers STING and TBK1 at the top and calls TBL1XR1 in the unprimed screen and HDAC3, borderline, in the primed screen, so each named NCoR/SMRT component passes FDR 0.10 in only one arm. The library has no non-targeting guides, so the FDR could not be calibrated.
